title: Reverse a C-string in place
description:
Write `void reverseInPlace(char* text)` that reverses a C-string without using any extra array or `std::string`.

Use two positions: one at the first character, one at the last (just before the terminator). Swap the characters they point at, move both inwards, and stop when they meet.

```
h e l l o \0        o e l l h \0        o l l e h \0
^       ^      ->     ^   ^        ->       ^
```
hints: Find the length first. Be careful with an empty string: `length - 1` on an unsigned zero wraps round to a huge number.
